parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves or call it off. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, so I need help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. My policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for me.
